note: script can shortlist claims whose body reduces to one 'means' element; model confirms it is a true single-means claim

title: Verify every means (and every component) has corresponding structure in the specification
check: Verify that each "means for" clause, and indeed each non-means component recited in the claims, is clearly described and identifiable as specific structure, material, or acts in the specification.
note: script extracts every means clause and every claimed component; locating the corresponding structure in the spec is a model task

title: Verify the set includes non-means claims alongside any means claims
check: Verify that if the draft uses means-plus-function claiming, it also includes one or more independent claims written with structural (non-means) language and made as broad as possible.
note: means vs non-means classification of independents is scriptable; breadth of the structural claims is a model call

title: Count the elements in the main claim and cut every unnecessary one
check: Verify the broadest independent claim recites the fewest elements consistent with an operative, complete assemblage that is novel and nonobvious.
note: element-by-element removal test only makes sense against the search results

title: Check that each element is recited at the broadest usable level of generality
check: Verify no element in the broad independent claim carries a specific material, dimension, count, or embodiment detail that is not needed to distinguish the prior art.
note: whether a specific is needed to distinguish the art requires the search

title: Test the claims against foreseeable design-arounds
check: Verify that for each key limitation, the auditor has considered how a competitor could achieve the same effect differently, and that the claim (and the specification's ramifications) covers that variation.
note: the ramifications support needed to broaden must exist at filing, so a failure here is uncurable

title: Verify each claim defines over the known prior art, with novelty in recited structure
check: Verify each independent claim recites something no single prior-art reference shows, expressed as positive, structurally supported novel hardware or a novel process step, and that the difference is nonobvious.
note: requires element-by-element comparison against the full text of the closest references

title: Read every claim under its least favorable interpretation
check: Verify that no claim wording admits a second reading under which the claim would read on the prior art or lose its point of novelty.
note: enumerating adverse readings and testing them against the art

section: Correspondence with the specification and drawings
title: Verify every claim term appears literally in the specification
check: Verify that every term and phrase used in the claims appears verbatim in the specification, with clear support or antecedent basis, and that every operation, structure, or result recited in a claim is fully described there.
note: verbatim presence of every claim term in the specification is deterministic; the deeper 'fully described' judgment belongs to E08/G43

section: Correspondence with the specification and drawings
title: Verify every claimed feature is shown in the drawings
check: Verify the drawings show every feature recited in the claims, and that all potentially relevant detail is in the drawings and specification before filing.
note: script enumerates claim elements; a model must find each in the figures. Rule 83 gaps cannot be cured post-filing

title: Test every claim against the judicial exceptions
check: Verify no claim is "directed to" a law of nature, natural phenomenon, or abstract idea without additional elements amounting to significantly more.
applies_to: all applications; especially software/business method and diagnostic

title: Run the software-as-means trap test on computer-implemented claims
check: Verify that any claim involving computers, software, or the Internet is directed to an application of the idea, rather than using a computer merely as a conventional means to implement an idea that could be practiced without one.

title: Build each independent claim as preamble, elements, interconnections, then broadening
check: Verify every independent claim contains a preamble, an affirmative recitation of each element (or step), explicit interconnections among all recited parts, and shows evidence of a deliberate broadening pass.
note: script can extract elements and flag orphans with no interconnection clause; the four-role read is a model task

title: Broaden the main claim to the fewest, most generalized elements that still clear the prior art
check: Verify the broadest independent claim has been stripped of nonessential elements and of unnecessary material, shape, and dimensional limitations, without becoming so broad that it reads on the prior art.
note: the broadening pass must be checked back against the search results in both directions

title: Preamble names a statutory class or a deliberately broad title
check: Verify each independent claim's preamble either names a statutory class ("A machine, comprising:") or gives a title/function broad enough that it cannot be construed narrowly.
note: preamble form and the open transition plus colon are scriptable; whether the title is narrowing needs a model

title: Recite every significant element affirmatively, as the subject of its own clause
check: Verify each significant element is introduced positively with "a"/"an" as the subject of its own clause, not smuggled in as a possessive, an object, or an assumed part.
note: script marks where each noun is first introduced and whether it is in subject position; model decides which are significant elements

title: Every functional recitation has structural or "means" support
check: Verify no claim contains a naked functional clause, that each function is preceded by an affirmative recitation of the element that performs it, and that no element is followed by another element's function.
note: script flags dangling participial clauses and functions with no preceding actor; whether the structure can perform the function is a model call

title: Purge vague and relative terms; hedge specific parameters instead
check: Verify no claim relies on undefined relative terms ("small," "large," "close") and that specific dimensions or parameters are hedged with "substantially," "about," or "predetermined" rather than recited absolutely.
note: relative terms, hard numbers and fixed counts are greppable; hedging decisions and PHOSITA definiteness need a model

title: Close each independent claim with a "whereby" clause that is not too narrow
check: Verify each independent claim ends with a "whereby" clause stating the advantage or use of the invention, phrased broadly enough that it cannot be turned into a narrowing limitation.
note: presence of a whereby clause is scriptable; whether it is too narrow is a model call

title: Independent claims should not be conspicuously short — but must avoid prolixity
check: Verify no independent claim is so terse that an examiner will read it as facially overbroad, and that any padding adds no unnecessary limitations.
note: claim length is scriptable; whether padding added real limitations is a model call

title: Do not cast claims in Jepson (two-part improvement) format unless required
check: Verify no claim uses a Jepson-style preamble reciting the old elements followed by a "the improvement comprising" cleavage clause, unless there is a specific reason for it.
note: 'the improvement comprising'/'characterized in that'/'of the type comprising' are greppable; whether Jepson form is justified needs a model

title: Apply the sketchability test to every independent claim
check: Verify that a reader who has not seen the drawings can sketch the invention from the claim alone.
note: the sketch test is inherently a comprehension exercise

title: Every term has a proper antecedent, and articles are used correctly
check: Verify every term used later in a claim was introduced earlier with "a"/"an," that subsequent references use "said" (identical term) or "the" (clearly implied term), and that "the said" never appears.
note: 'the said' and unmatched back-references are scriptable; distinguishing a clearly-implied 'the' from a missing antecedent needs a model

title: No term debuts in the claims; every claimed part appears in the drawings and specification
check: Verify every term and every part recited in any claim is already used in the specification and depicted in the drawings.
note: claim-term-in-spec matching is deterministic, but confirming each claimed part is depicted requires the sheets

title: Label every "means" and follow it with a function or structure
check: Verify each "means" recitation carries a distinguishing adjective or ordinal ("first means," "urging means") and is immediately followed by "for ..." plus a function, or by a structural recitation.
note: bare 'means' with no modifier and missing 'for' are scriptable; a means-plus-structure tail must be judged

title: The specification discloses corresponding structure for every means clause, in the same words
check: Verify that for each unique "means for <function>" in the claims, the specification describes hardware or an element performing that function, using the same words used in the claim.
note: script tables every distinct means clause and searches the spec for the same functional wording; whether the passage describes an implementing element is a model call

title: Use open transitional language and avoid disjunctives
check: Verify every claim uses "comprising" or "including" rather than "consisting" or "having only," and that no claim uses a disjunctive "or" expression except to recite two equivalent parts or a disjunctive machine function.
applies_to: all applications (closed transitions are a particular risk in chemical claims)
note: 'consisting'/'having only'/disjunctive 'or' are greppable but over-flag; a model must confirm each is unintended

title: Enforce claim punctuation and typographic hygiene
check: Verify no claim contains abbreviations, dashes, parentheses, or quotation marks, and that each claim has exactly one capital letter and one period apart from lettered subparagraphs.
note: pure typographic check: abbreviations, dashes, parentheses, quotes, one capital, one period

title: Format the claim set: subparagraphs, hanging indents, line skips, and page layout
check: Verify long claims are broken into lettered subparagraphs in hanging-indent style, that a line is skipped between claims so inter-claim space exceeds intra-claim line space, and that the claims begin on a new page with adequate line spacing.
note: subparagraph lettering, hanging indents, inter-claim line skips, page break and line spacing are all deterministic layout properties

title: Every independent claim carries a backup set of dependent claims covering every novel feature
check: Verify each independent claim is followed by several dependent claims, and that every possibly novel or significant feature and combination of features of the invention appears somewhere in the claim set.
note: dependents-per-independent counts are scriptable; matching spec features against the claim set needs a model

title: Each dependent claim uses proper referencing form
check: Verify every dependent claim opens by referring to its parent by the parent's exact title in the first or second line, and uses "wherein" to narrow an existing element or "further including"/"further comprising" to add elements.
note: script checks the reference position, exact-title match to the parent preamble and the transitional word; whether 'wherein' or 'further comprising' is correct depends on narrowing vs adding

title: Dependent claims narrow only — no substitutions and no class changes
check: Verify each dependent claim either recites a parent element more specifically or adds elements, never substituting a different part, changing an element to a different type or kind, or switching statutory class.
note: cross-class dependency is detectable from preambles; spotting a substitution rather than a narrowing needs a model

title: Dependent claims need structural support, and must narrow the means rather than the function
check: Verify no dependent claim recites a purely functional or operational limitation without structure or "means" to support it, and that a dependent claim limiting a parent's means-plus-function element modifies the means, not the function.
note: script can shortlist dependents whose added limitation is purely operational; means-vs-function narrowing is a model call

title: Depend directly from the independent claim and number dependents near their parents
check: Verify almost all dependent claims depend directly from an independent claim rather than from another dependent claim, and that each dependent claim is numbered as close as possible to its parent.
note: the dependency graph and parent-to-child numbering distance are computed deterministically

title: Use significant limitations and cover all feasible permutations
check: Verify dependent claims recite limitations an infringer would plausibly adopt, and that feasible combinations of the subsidiary features are claimed, not just each feature individually.
note: script can build the permutation matrix of subsidiary features and find gaps; commercial significance of each limitation is a model call

title: Include single-element differentiation claims, one maximal claim, and one publicly detectable claim
check: Verify most dependent claims recite a single added element (for claim differentiation), that at least one dependent claim recites as many parts as possible, and that at least one claim covers something whose infringement can be observed publicly.
note: added-element counts per dependent and the maximal claim are scriptable; public detectability of infringement is a model call

title: Provide multiple, substantially differently phrased independent claim sets, with and without means clauses
check: Verify the application contains second and third sets of claims whose independent claims phrase the invention in substantially different ways, including one set using means-plus-function clauses and one set without.
note: script can diff the independent claims for near-identity; whether the phrasings are substantially different approaches is a model call

title: Include an independent method claim and its dependent set wherever possible
check: Verify the application includes at least one independent method (process) claim with its own dependent claims whenever the invention involves any dynamic operation.
note: presence of a method independent claim is scriptable; whether the invention admits one, and whether the steps are real acts, is a model call

title: Every method claim step is an action step in gerund form
check: Verify each substantive clause of every method claim begins with an "-ing" action word, that hardware is introduced with "providing," and that "comprising the steps of" is not used.
note: every substantive clause opening with an -ing word, hardware introduced by 'providing', and the ban on 'comprising the steps of' are all string-level checks

title: Every process claim is tied to a machine or recites a transformation
check: Verify each process claim is either tied in a substantial way to a particular machine or apparatus, or recites the transformation of an article into a different state or thing.
applies_to: all applications with method claims; especially software/business method
note: naming the machine or the transformation from the claim text alone is legal judgment

title: Method claims focus all steps on a single actor
check: Verify each method claim's steps could all be performed by one actor, rather than being split between a service provider and its customers or users.
applies_to: all applications with method claims; especially software/business method and networked systems
note: annotating each step with its real-world actor cannot be mechanised

title: Software inventions include a tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium claim
check: Verify a software invention is claimed not only as a method and machine but also as a manufacture — a tangible, non-transitorily encoded computer-readable medium — with a mirrored set of dependent claims.
note: presence of a medium claim, the 'tangible'/'non-transitory' wording and leftover 'The method of claim X' preambles are greppable; mirroring of the claim body needs a model

title: Each independent claim stands entirely on its own
check: Verify no independent claim refers to, incorporates, relies on, or borrows a referent from any other claim.
note: cross-claim references are mechanical, but the ordinal and borrowed-antecedent cases are the antecedent-basis judgment again

section: Claim count, fees, and multiple dependency
title: Keep the set within three independent and twenty total claims unless justified
check: Count independent claims and total claims and verify the set does not exceed three independent or twenty total claims without a documented justification based on the invention's complexity.
note: independent/total claim counts and the resulting excess-claim fee tier are deterministic

section: Claim count, fees, and multiple dependency
title: Avoid multiple dependent claims
check: Verify no claim depends on more than one previous claim (for example, "The widget of claims 1 or 2 wherein ...").
note: a dependent claim referring to more than one prior claim is a pure pattern match

title: Confirm drawings exist and show every feature recited in the claims
check: Verify that a drawing is filed wherever one is needed to understand the invention, and that every element and limitation recited in the claims is actually depicted in at least one figure.
note: Script can enumerate claim elements and numerals; only a vision pass can confirm each element is actually depicted.

title: Verify the drawings are complete enough to stand alone, because no new matter can be added later
check: Verify that the drawings contain everything technically necessary to disclose the invention, on the assumption that nothing can be added to them after the filing date.
note: Sufficiency of technical disclosure on the sheets; no mechanisation. Failure is uncurable (new matter).

title: Verify every reference numeral is mentioned in the specification and numerals are used consistently
check: Verify that each reference numeral on the sheets appears in the specification text, that the same part carries the same numeral in every figure, and that no numeral designates two different parts.
note: Bidirectional numeral list is scriptable only after OCR of the sheets; cross-figure 'same part, same numeral' requires seeing what each numeral points at, so not mechanical.

title: Verify graphic symbols and labeled boxes for conventional features are defined in the specification
check: Verify that every graphical symbol, encircled letter, or labeled rectangular box standing in for a conventional component is expressly explained in the specification text.

title: Verify improvement inventions separate the new portion and label prior-art figures
check: Verify that where the invention is an improvement on an existing machine, the improved portion is shown apart from the old structure and any figure depicting prior art is labeled as such in its figure number.
note: '(prior art)' caption tag is extractable; deciding whether the improvement is separated from old structure is visual adjudication.

title: Verify every drawing sheet is one of the two permitted sizes and all sheets match
check: Verify that all drawing sheets are exactly the same size and are either U.S. letter (8½" x 11") or A4 (210 mm x 297 mm).
note: Page dimensions of every sheet measured from the PDF; pure comparison.

title: Verify the margins are clear of all lines and writing, with no border lines and correct crosshairs
check: Verify that nothing is drawn or written in the margins, that no margin border lines are present, and that crosshairs mark two diagonally opposite margin corners.
note: Margin box is measurable, but detecting stray ink, border rectangles and crosshairs in the margin is a visual check.

title: Verify sheet physical integrity, paper quality, and single-sided use, and identify each sheet on the back
check: Verify the sheets are clean, hole-free, unwrinkled, untorn, unfolded, printed on one side only on suitable paper, and carry the title and first inventor's name and phone number on the back.
note: Paper stock, holes, creases, tears and back-of-sheet identification cannot be established from an electronic copy at all; needs the physical sheets or a statement from the filer.

title: Verify all lines are crisp, black, instrument-made, and free of solid black areas
check: Verify every line on every sheet is sharp, uniformly dense, and perfectly black, drawn with drafting tools or CAD rather than freehand, with no solid black fills.
note: Line density and rasterisation can be measured from the image; freehand vs instrument work is adjudicated.

title: Verify each line type carries its correct meaning and forbidden lines are absent
check: Verify that solid, hidden, projection, and phantom lines are used only for their defined purposes, that broken lines never depict actual parts of the invention, and that no construction, center, or figure-connecting lines appear.
note: Requires understanding what each broken line is meant to represent.

title: Verify sectioned parts are hatched correctly and shading follows the 45-degree convention
check: Verify every part shown in section is filled with adequately spaced slanted parallel hatching, and that any surface or edge shading is consistent with light from the upper left at 45 degrees.
note: Hatch spacing and shading direction are visual properties of the sheets.

title: Verify the scale and lettering survive two-thirds reduction
check: Verify each figure is drawn at a scale large enough that no detail is crowded when the sheet is reduced to two-thirds size for reproduction, and that all lettering is legible at that reduction.
note: Lettering height is measurable; crowding at two-thirds reduction is adjudicated on the rendered image.

title: Verify the set includes enough views of the right kinds, with exploded parts bracketed and modifications in separate figures
check: Verify the drawings include as many views as are needed to show the invention, favour perspective over plain engineering views, bracket the parts of exploded figures, show modifications in separate figures, and include one comprehensive view suitable for the Official Gazette.
note: Whether the view set is sufficient for the invention is not mechanisable.

title: Verify sectional and enlarged views are properly designated on the parent figure
check: Verify every sectional view has its cutting plane marked on the general figure with a broken line, numerals matching the sectional figure number, and arrows showing the viewing direction, and that every enlarged view's area is circled and numbered on the parent figure.
note: Requires tracing section lines and encircled details back to the parent figure on the sheets.

title: Verify figures are separately and consecutively numbered, unconnected, and assemblable across sheets
check: Verify every view carries its own consecutive figure number, that no figure touches, connects to, or is nested inside another, and that any drawing spanning multiple sheets can be assembled without concealing parts.
note: Figure-number continuity alone would be mechanical, but 'unconnected' and 'assemblable across sheets' are visual, so the item as a whole is not.

title: Verify sheet orientation, lettering orientation, and sheet numbering are consistent
check: Verify all views on a sheet share one orientation, that lettering follows that orientation, that the sheet number and total appear at the top in centered oversized numerals, and that figure legends are correctly placed.
note: Sheet n/total placement is measurable; consistent view orientation across a sheet is visual.

title: Verify reference numerals are plain, large enough, uncircled, and clear of hatching and other lines
check: Verify every reference numeral is plainly and legibly formed, at least ⅛" high, not encircled, not crossing or mingling with other lines, and not sitting on hatched or shaded surfaces unless unavoidable.
note: Numeral height is measurable; encirclement and collision with hatching are visual.

title: Verify every reference numeral has a lead line, and that arrowheads are used only for assemblies
check: Verify each reference numeral is connected by a lead line to the feature it designates, with no arrowhead on lead lines pointing to individual parts.
note: Lead-line presence and arrowhead usage are purely visual properties of the sheets.

title: Verify the sheets carry no descriptive or extraneous matter beyond permitted legends
check: Verify each figure is captioned with its figure number alone, that any descriptive legends appear only in rectangular boxes, on flowcharts, or on piping lines, and that nothing unrelated to the claimed invention appears on the sheets.
note: OCR extracts every word on the sheets; a model decides what is extraneous or an impermissible caption.

title: Verify colour drawings or photos are accompanied by the petition, fee, and specification statement
check: Verify that if any drawing or photo is in colour, the filing includes a petition explaining why colour is necessary, the petition fee, the required first-paragraph statement in the brief description of the drawings, and the correct number of sets or EFS-Web document code.
note: Colour detection and petition/statement presence are extractable; necessity of colour is adjudicated. The missing first-paragraph statement is not cleanly curable after filing.

title: Verify photographs are used only where necessary, with a petition, and meet reproduction quality
check: Verify that no photograph is used where a line drawing would suffice, that any black and white photo is supported by a petition explaining its necessity, and that all photos reproduce every detail and illustrate all features of the invention.
note: Whether a line drawing would suffice, and whether the photo shows every feature, are visual judgments on the sheets.

title: Verify the drawing set as a whole is well executed despite lax PTO enforcement
check: Verify the drawings are of a standard the auditor would be willing to put in front of an examiner or a judge, rather than merely the minimum that might slip through.
note: Holistic quality read of the set; no mechanisation.

title: Verify uniform sheet size and 1-inch margins on every sheet
check: Every typed sheet of the specification, claims, and abstract is the same size (U.S. letter or A4), single-sided, and carries at least 2.5 cm (1") top, bottom, left, and right margins.
note: Sheet size and all four margins measured from the PDF.

title: Verify line spacing, typeface, and sheet numbering
check: The text is 1.5- or double-spaced, set in a conventional sans-serif face of at least 12 point, unjustified, with sheets numbered top or bottom, centered, inside the margin.
note: Spacing, font family, point size, justification and page numbering are all extractable from the document.

title: Verify claims and abstract start on new pages, with the abstract last
check: The claims begin on a fresh page, each claim is separated from the next by an extra line, the abstract begins on its own page and is the last sheet, and the title appears on the first page.
note: Page-break positions and part ordering are deterministic from the document structure.

title: Verify the draft is not formatted to imitate an issued patent, and consider paragraph numbering
check: The application is laid out as a double-spaced typed document, not as two narrow single-spaced columns with a references-cited list, and paragraphs are numbered [0001], [0002] in brackets.
note: Paragraph numbering and sentence length are measurable; 'looks like an issued patent' is adjudicated.

title: Verify drawing sheets are all present and show every claimed feature
check: Every drawing sheet referenced in the specification is in the packet, the drawings depict each feature recited in the claims, and each sheet is numbered "n/total" below the top margin with the inventor's name on the top back.
note: Owned by drawings even though it sits in Part I; needs the sheets to confirm claimed features are actually depicted.

title: Verify that all true inventors, and only true inventors, are named
check: Every named person contributed to the conception of at least one claim, and no financier, employer, supervisor, or assistant has been added.
note: Cannot be verified from documents at all — who contributed conception to which claim is established only by interviewing the inventors. Name consistency across ADS/declaration/spec is the only documentary part.

title: Verify the Patent Application Declaration is complete, signed, dated, and consistent with the ADS
check: A declaration on the correct form variant is present, signed and dated by each inventor, with the title and inventor names identical to those on the Application Data Sheet.
note: Wrong or unsigned inventor declaration is a blocking defect, not a curable formality.

title: Verify no changes were made to the application after the declaration was signed
check: The application text is byte-identical to what existed when the declaration was signed, and any handwritten correction is in ink, dated, and initialed in the adjacent margin *before* the signature date.
note: Cannot be fully verified from documents — a clean retype after signature leaves no trace on the page; requires the drafting history and the signer's account.

title: Verify the Application Data Sheet is present and its optional sections are correctly resolved
check: Form PTO/AIA/14 is in the packet, "Filing by Reference" is left blank, the AIA transition statement box is resolved deliberately, and the access opt-out boxes reflect the applicant's actual intent.
note: Whether the transition statement and access opt-out boxes are correctly resolved depends on facts the applicant must supply.

title: Verify the ADS is signed by a party authorized to sign it
check: The ADS signature matches one of the three permitted scenarios, and in particular a patent practitioner has signed if any applicant is a juristic entity.
note: Which signature scenario applies turns on whether any applicant is a juristic entity — an intake fact.

title: Verify any provisional application benefit claim appears in both the specification and the ADS
check: If a PPA is being relied on, its serial number and filing date appear in the "CROSS REFERENCE TO RELATED APPLICATIONS" section of the specification *and* in the ADS, and the application is being filed within one year of the PPA.
note: Presence of the benefit claim in both places, the one-year date arithmetic and the inventor-overlap set comparison are all deterministic. Loss of the PPA date is uncurable, so blocking.

title: Verify small entity status is actually earned before it is asserted
check: If small entity status is claimed, the invention has not been assigned or licensed — and there is no obligation to assign or license it — to a for-profit company with more than 500 employees.
note: Cannot be verified from documents in the packet — entitlement turns on employment, consulting and funding agreements and on any obligation to assign, which only the applicant can disclose.

title: Verify micro entity status against every prong, and that the certification form is attached
check: If micro entity status is claimed, each prong of the definition is satisfied and Form PTO/SB/15A or 15B is included in the packet.
note: Cannot be verified from documents — lifetime application count and prior-year gross income are facts only the inventor can supply. Only the SB/15A-15B presence check is documentary.

title: Verify the claim count, page count, and filing mode against the fee calculation
check: Total claims, independent claims, multiple dependent claims, application page count, and paper-versus-electronic filing are all counted correctly and reflected in the fees being paid.
note: Claim counts, multiple-dependency detection, page count and excess-claim fee arithmetic are all deterministic.

title: Verify the payment instrument is complete, valid, and funded, and that all three basic fees are paid together
check: The basic filing, search, and examination fees are being paid simultaneously, and the check, money order, or Credit Card Payment Form is complete, signed, and backed by sufficient funds.
applies_to: all applications (payment form varies by filing mode)
note: Form completeness is documentary, but whether the account or card is actually funded cannot be verified from the packet.

section: Information Disclosure Statement and the duty of candour
title: Verify the IDS is filed with the application or calendared within three months
check: If any inventor is aware of relevant prior art, an IDS either accompanies the packet or a diarised deadline exists to file it within three months of filing (or before the first Office Action).
applies_to: all applications where prior art is known
note: Cannot be verified from documents — whether an IDS is owed depends on what the inventors personally know. Duty of candour, so blocking.

section: Information Disclosure Statement and the duty of candour
title: Verify the IDS lists every known material reference on the proper form, not just in the Background
check: Every prior-art reference known to any inventor or assignee is listed on Form PTO/SB/08a or 08b, including references already discussed in the specification's prior-art section.
applies_to: all applications where prior art is known
note: Search hits can be reconciled against SB/08 mechanically, but references known only from personal knowledge require interviewing the inventors. Duty of candour, so blocking.

section: Information Disclosure Statement and the duty of candour
title: Verify copies of non-U.S. references and an explanation of non-English references are attached
check: The packet includes a copy of every cited foreign patent and every non-patent-literature item, plus a concise explanation of the relevance of any non-English-language reference.
applies_to: all applications citing non-U.S. or non-patent prior art
note: Attachment-per-row is extractable; adequacy of the Rule 98 concise explanation is adjudicated. Curable by supplemental IDS.

section: Information Disclosure Statement and the duty of candour
title: Verify the IDS is not padded with cumulative or irrelevant references, and that copies are clean
check: The reference list contains only genuinely relevant, non-duplicative items, and every submitted copy is free of handwritten marks and notes.
note: Relevance and cumulativeness of each cited reference is a reading judgment.

section: Information Disclosure Statement and the duty of candour
title: Verify material information other than prior art has been disclosed
check: Any known relevant litigation, rival inventorship assertion, or pre-filing sale of a product embodying the invention is disclosed by narrative statement.
note: The archetype unverifiable item — litigation, rival inventorship assertions and pre-filing sales are known only to the applicant and can be established solely by interview. Duty of candour, so blocking.

title: Verify a Nonpublication Request is not being filed if foreign filing is possible
check: An NPR is present only where the applicant has decided *not* to file a corresponding application abroad or under an international agreement requiring 18-month publication.
note: Cannot be resolved from documents — the NPR is proper only if foreign-filing intent is a firm 'no', which must be asked. Explicitly blocking.

title: Verify the NPR is filed with the application and the 45-day revocation duty is recorded
check: Any NPR is in the packet at filing (not planned for later), is signed by the first inventor, and the file records the 45-day revocation obligation that attaches if the application is later filed abroad.
note: An NPR omitted at filing can never be added later, so this is not a curable formality.

title: Verify the electronic packet contains the right parts, in the right formats
check: The EFS-Web packet consists of the drawings, specification/claims/abstract, declaration, and ADS — with the paper-only parts omitted — and every PDF meets the 300 DPI, white-background requirement.
note: DPI, background colour and file type are measurable; correct document set is adjudicated.

title: Verify the uploaded documents validate and the Acknowledgment Receipt is complete
check: The Review Documents page shows all four application parts with no fatal errors, the correct entity size was selected at fee calculation, and the printed Acknowledgment Receipt lists everything that was filed.
note: Verified against the live EFS-Web Review Documents page and the printed Acknowledgment Receipt, not against the pre-filing packet.

title: Verify the Patent Application Transmittal and Fee Transmittal are complete and signed
check: Every applicable box on the current application transmittal (PTO/AIA/15 or successor) is checked with matching counts, and both the transmittal and the fee transmittal are signed and dated.
note: Reconciling declared box counts against actual contents needs reliable checkbox extraction from the form, so a script alone would produce false passes.

title: Verify a self-addressed, stamped receipt postcard listing every enclosed paper
check: A self-addressed, postage-paid postcard is enclosed whose back itemises every paper in the packet and leaves room for the PTO's date and serial number sticker.

title: Verify the mailing method is Priority Mail Express and not a prohibited alternative
check: The packet is going by "Priority Mail Express Post Office to Addressee" with the PME number entered on the transmittal letter, and no certificate of mailing or courier service is being used.
note: Cannot be verified from documents alone — the actual mailing service used is an act reported by the filer; only the PME number field on the transmittal is documentary. A non-PME route irrevocably changes the filing date.

title: Verify assembly order, retained copies, and an independent second reading
check: The papers are assembled in the prescribed order and fastened correctly, a complete copy is retained, and someone other than the drafter has checked the packet against the rules.
applies_to: paper filing (retention and second reading apply to all)
note: Assembly, fastening, retention and the independent second reading are physical-process facts.

title: Verify any assignment being recorded has a complete cover sheet and the recordation fee
check: If ownership is being transferred, the signed assignment is accompanied by a completed Recordation Form Cover Sheet, the recordation fee, and — where filed with the application — the corresponding transmittal and fee-transmittal entries.
note: Whether an assignment exists at all is an intake fact.

section: Petitions to Make Special and prioritized examination
title: Verify any Petition to Make Special rests on one of the five permitted grounds and has its supporting declaration
check: A petition to make special asserts only a currently recognized ground listed in MPEP 708.02 and is accompanied by the required evidence.
applies_to: applications including a Petition to Make Special
note: Whether the asserted ground falls within the five permitted categories is a legal reading.

section: Petitions to Make Special and prioritized examination
title: Verify any Accelerated Examination or Track One request meets its structural requirements
check: An Accelerated Examination petition is filed electronically with Form SB/28, the application has no more than three independent and 20 total claims and claims one invention only, and the required fee is included; a Track One request carries its prioritized examination fee.
applies_to: applications requesting accelerated or prioritized examination
note: Claim-limit counting is mechanical; sufficiency of the SB/28 content is adjudicated.

title: Verify the design application packet contains all required parts and the five specification elements
check: A design filing includes the required specification elements under 37 CFR 1.154, black-line drawings, a declaration, an ADS, and payment (plus paper-only transmittal parts if not filed electronically).

title: Verify design drawings show only the exterior, with shading, and enough views to cover every surface
check: The design drawings show only external appearance, use no reference numerals, are executed with good surface and edge shading, and include enough figures to disclose every detail of the external surface.
note: Purely visual and uncurable — an undisclosed face of the article cannot be added after filing, and the omission is only detectable by looking at the sheets.

title: Verify the design application has one claim, one embodiment, and an IDS plan
check: The application recites exactly one claim in the prescribed form, is directed to a single embodiment, and has an IDS calendared within three months if any prior art is known.
note: Claim count is mechanical; single-embodiment and IDS-need questions are adjudicated.

title: Recompute and calendar the provisional-to-nonprovisional one-year conversion date
check: If the draft claims benefit of a provisional, verify that the regular application is going out within one year of the PPA's filing date and that the same one-year date is calendared for foreign Convention filings.
applies_to: Applications claiming benefit of a Provisional Patent Application
note: One-year anniversary with weekend/holiday rollover is pure date arithmetic from the PPA filing receipt; the docket entries themselves must be confirmed with the filer.

title: Confirm the PPA's disclosure actually supports the claims being filed
check: Verify that everything the regular application claims priority for is described in the provisional in enabling, best-mode terms — not merely mentioned.
applies_to: Applications claiming benefit of a Provisional Patent Application
note: Claim-by-claim written-description mapping against the provisional; no mechanisation.

title: Establish that no pre-filing public disclosure has already foreclosed rights
check: Verify, on the record, whether the invention was published, offered for sale, sold, or publicly used before the intended filing date, and by whom.
note: Cannot be verified from documents — first publication, offer for sale, sale and public use dates exist only in the applicant's knowledge and records and must be obtained by interview.

title: Protect foreign-filing rights against pre-filing sale or disclosure
check: Confirm that no sale or public disclosure of invention details has occurred before the U.S. filing date, and that any Non-Convention Country filings are planned before the invention becomes publicly known.
applies_to: All applications with any foreign filing intent
note: Cannot be verified from documents — depends entirely on the applicant's foreign-filing intent and on any pre-filing sale or disclosure they report.

title: Calendar the Convention year and the PCT dates from the U.S. filing date
check: Verify that the 1-year Convention date, the 30-month foreign filing date, and the 22-month Chapter II date are all computed from the U.S. filing date and entered in the docket at filing.
note: Convention, 30-month and 22-month intervals are date arithmetic once the target-country list and the U.S. filing date are supplied; the seed date is the future filing receipt date.

title: Verify the foreign-filing license or the 6-month wait
check: Confirm that no foreign filing is scheduled within 6 months of the U.S. filing date unless a foreign-filing license has been granted on the filing receipt.
note: Cannot be concluded pre-filing — the licence appears on a filing receipt that does not yet exist; the deliverable is a gated tickler, not a pass/fail.

title: Fix the 18-month publication date and the Nonpublication Request position
check: Confirm the 18-month publication date is docketed and that the decision to file or omit a Nonpublication Request is made and documented before the packet goes out.
applies_to: All applications; critical where foreign filing is contemplated
note: Consistency between the NPR position in the packet and the foreign-filing plan; the plan is an intake fact.

title: Apply the weekend and holiday rollover rule to every computed date
check: Verify that each calendared date has been tested against PTO closure days and rolled forward where required.
note: Every computed date tested against weekends and the ten PTO holidays; pure calendar arithmetic over the docket dates.

title: Verify the packet contains every required paper and a complete, correctly computed fee set
check: Confirm the packet holds the transmittal, ADS, declaration, specification, claims, drawings, and fee transmittal, and that the fee total covers filing, search, examination, excess claims, multiple dependent claims, and any application size fee at the correct entity rate.
applies_to: All applications; entity rate matters for small/micro entity
note: Required-paper presence, claim/sheet counts and fee arithmetic at the asserted entity rate are deterministic. Fatal in severity but curable after filing by a Notice to File Missing Parts plus surcharge, so not blocking.

title: Confirm the declaration form matches the ADS decision and covers every inventor
check: Verify that the packet uses the declaration variant appropriate to whether an Application Data Sheet is being filed, and that every named inventor is captured, using the supplemental sheet if needed.
note: Form-variant and inventor-list cross-checks are extractable; signature and date presence on a scanned form needs adjudication. Missing or wrong inventor declaration is blocking.

title: Check that every PTO form in the packet is a current, post-AIA version
check: Verify the expiration date printed at the top of each PTO form and confirm the packet uses the form set for applications filed on or after September 16, 2012.
note: Reads the 'Approved for use through' date and the AIA-series form number off each form.

title: Resolve the optional-form decisions before the packet closes
check: Confirm a conscious, documented decision on each conditional form — Nonpublication Request, IDS and cover letter, Petition to Make Special, Request Under MPEP 707.07(j), credit card form, and assignment plus recordation cover sheet.
applies_to: All applications; foreign filing intent drives the NPR decision
note: The failure mode is inconsistency between conditional forms and the file's intent, which requires reasoning across the packet.

title: Verify the physical and editorial hygiene of the assembled papers
check: Confirm the papers are properly formatted for PTO submission and that no template artifacts remain in any RTF-derived form.
applies_to: All applications, especially paper filings and forms edited from USPTO templates
note: Bracketed instructional text is regex-findable; orphaned alternative clauses and stranded signature lines are adjudicated.

title: Confirm the correct PTO destination and correspondence routing for each paper
check: Verify that papers requiring a special Mail Stop are addressed to it and that the correspondence address on the ADS is one the applicant will monitor.
applies_to: All applications, especially paper filings and packets containing assignments
note: Mail Stop routing is documentary, but whether the correspondence address is actually monitored cannot be verified from documents.
